description: 【提供:国土交通省 那賀川河川事務所、福井河川国道事務所】ALB(航空レーザ測深)データ [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 公益社団法人　土木学会. ■ALB（航空レーザ測深）とは ALBは、陸上の地形計測において、既に広く利用されている航空レーザ計測装置と同様のシステムを利用しますが、発射するレーザの波長が従来とは異なっています。 陸上計測で使用する近赤外線レーザは、水に吸収又は水面で反射されるため、川底の形状の計測には使用できませんでした。 一方、ALBで使用する緑色レーザは、水中... Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 公益社団法人　土木学会. It offers 2 resource(s) in geojson. The portal shows 2024-10-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Government of Japan Standard Terms of Use (compatible with CC-BY-4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
